summary_md: **Paxeer Network Protocol ([@paxeer_app](https://x.com/paxeer_app/status/2115941755346436392))** open-sources **Keith**, a Rust self-improving harness that rewrites its own machinery rather than its prompt: each new version is built in isolation, tested against the current one and adopted only if it measurably improves ([Sidiora-Labs/keith-agent-harness](https://github.com/Sidiora-Labs/keith-agent-harness)).
